dialogues.speaker: Backhaus
dialogues.text: Strange... I've never seen one like that before. If I could just get a little closer to take a proper look...

dialogues.speaker: Backhaus
dialogues.text: I... ah, right. I'm a scholar. My research focuses on hilichurls...

dialogues.speaker: Backhaus
dialogues.text: This is actually my first time conducting a study out in the field on my own. It would be a lot easier if my teacher were here.

dialogues.speaker: Backhaus
dialogues.text: I... I'm observing the hilichurls in this area. And, well, to be honest, I've found a rather unusual samachurl nearby.

dialogues.speaker: Backhaus
dialogues.text: The entire tribe here seems to revolve around it. It's technically a shaman, but its status is almost that of a "king."

dialogues.speaker: Backhaus
dialogues.text: If this really is a previously undocumented ecological structure... my findings might even surprise my teacher...

dialogues.speaker: Backhaus
dialogues.text: Alright. I still need to write down a few more observations...

dialogues.speaker: Backhaus
dialogues.text: Yes, her name is Livingstone. She's a leading scholar in hilichurl studies, and quite an impressive adventurer too. Maybe she'll be able to make sense of this...
